scope: Every current catalog route whose engine is table-csv or table-operations.

handoff_policy.transport: Only targets returned by compatibleHandoffTargets are offered; the runtime handoff transport limit is authoritative.

routes.upgrade: Bounded table preview, explicit delimiter/UTF-8/dynamicTyping=false dialect, exact zero affected rows/cells.
Bounded result preview; exact BOM and record-break changes; parsed cells preserved; affected rows/cells remain zero; compatible CSV handoffs only.
Explicit detected delimiter/confidence/candidates and UTF-8 string-preserving dialect; inspection reports zero affected rows/cells.
Exact input/output bytes, detected/requested encoding, BOM/record-break/replacement counts, zero semantic affected rows/cells, bounded output preview.
Whole-row or explicit key-column dedupe; exact input/output/removed rows and affected cells; stable first occurrence; compatible CSV handoffs only.
Explicit selected/reordered column indexes and names, dropped columns, missing-cell fill count and row-count effect.
Explicit source-index mapping/rename/reorder with dropped-column and ragged-cell disclosure; existing narrow route retained.
Explicit filter column/name, case policy, NULL tokens/empty policy, text type policy and input/output/rejected row counts.
Explicit sort column/name, lexical/numeric/date comparator, case policy, NULL placement, invalid typed values as NULL, stable row count.
Explicit group key columns/names, case/NULL grouping policy, strict numeric aggregate policy and input/output group row counts.
Explicit left/right key columns/names, case/NULL key policy, matched/unmatched/output counts and pre-materialization row/cell explosion estimate/guard.
Explicit group/value/aggregate column names, case/NULL grouping policy, strict numeric aggregate policy and input/output row counts.
Deterministic preserve/unique header policy; all CSV cell values remain strings; route is the real JSON conversion target for compatible table handoffs.
Explicit first-record/union header schema with dropped-key disclosure and CSV handoff output.
Quote-aware TSV parsing and deterministic CSV serialization with shared bounded table/result behavior.
Deterministic transpose with bounded table limits and compatible CSV handoff output.
Per-column missing/present counts and missing rate with inspection-only string-preserving input semantics.
Per-column number/boolean/date/string/empty evidence with dominant/mixed classification; profiling does not coerce source cells.
Optional explicit key columns, duplicate group counts and bounded examples without mutating source rows.
Explicit label/value columns, count/sum/min/max aggregation and bounded bar count; CSV handoff remains available.
Real PostgreSQL/MySQL/SQLite SQL-text target with explicit type/NULL policy and safe identifier/value quoting; SQL is never executed.
Streaming huge-CSV split strategy with repeated header, dialect/newline preservation, abort and bounded source parser buffer.
Explicit keyed compare with duplicate-key ambiguity, null/case policy, changed-cell provenance, bounded preview and complete accepted export.
Bounded local FatturaPA XML reader with schema/version provenance, hostile XML refusal, explicit invoice fields and isolated malformed-field errors.
Batch FatturaPA to stable CSV/table export with per-file failure isolation, source/schema columns, bounded preview and represented-total reconciliation.

refusals.reason: The current generated catalog has no XLSX route that accepts a CSV table handoff. Ticket 60 does not invent or add an XLSX converter.
